core_size.meaning: Line count measures source size; it does not establish feature completeness or agent quality.

failure_history: An initial full-suite run had a parse error in a new test function; it was corrected and the complete suite passed.
A cold focused functional fixture timed out during first-use compilation; ordinary functional fixtures now allow compilation time while explicit deadline tests retain short limits.
GUI probes initially searched hidden structured data as visible text; connection testing now displays latency and restart checks wait for the completed generation before opening diagnostics.
Earlier editor transport tests left a Julia child after disposal; bounded termination and a non-cooperative real-child test now verify closure.
limits: Core size target and complete upstream synthesis remain unfinished.
No OS sandbox or Windows descendant-process verification.
OAuth, server sampling/elicitation, native multimedia model projection and real JuliaMCP interoperability remain pending.
Actual GUI verification uses extension development Webview and a native development Workbench; a complete desktop installer is not produced.
Custom bounded schema support is not full JSON Schema dialect certification.
Live external model/server credentials are not used in offline fixtures.
